fields.title: Match
fields.description: Defines the logic for the matching criteria:

fields.title: Join columns
fields.description:
Defines the columns from the top input ('left' table) and the bottom input ('right' table) that should be used for joining.
For two rows to be joined, the row from the left input table must have the same value in column A as the row from the right
 input table in column B. RowIDs can be compared to RowIDs or regular columns, in which case the RowID will be interpreted
 as a string value.

fields.title: Compare values in join columns by
fields.description: Defines how to compare the values in the join columns:

fields.title: Matching rows
fields.description: Include rows that match on the selected column pairs.

fields.title: Left unmatched rows
fields.description: Include rows from the left input table for which no matching row in the right input table is found.

fields.title: Right unmatched rows
fields.description: Include rows from the right input table for which no matching row in the left input table is found.

fields.title: Top input ('left' table)
fields.description: Select columns from top input ('left' table) that should be included or excluded in the output table.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Bottom input ('right' table)
fields.description: Select columns from bottom input ('right' table) that should be included or excluded in the output table.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Merge join columns
fields.description:
If selected, the join columns of the right input table are merged into their join partners of the left input table.
The merged column is named like the left join column if one of its join partners in the right table has the same name.
If the join partners have different names, the merged column is named in the form "left column=right column".

fields.title: If there are duplicate column names
fields.description: Defines what should happen if there are column names included in the output that have the same name:

fields.title: Custom suffix
fields.description: The suffix to be added to the column name of the right table

fields.title: Split join result into multiple tables
fields.description:
Output unmatched rows (if selected under "Include in output") at the second and third output port, i.e.
  • top: Matching rows
  • middle: Left unmatched rows
  • bottom: Right unmatched rows

fields.title: RowIDs
fields.description: Defines how the RowIDs of the output table are generated:

fields.title: Separator
fields.description: The separator to be added in between RowIDs of the input tables to generate the RowIDs of the output table.

fields.title: Row order
fields.description: Defines the row order for the output table rows.

fields.title: Maximum number of temporary files
fields.description:
Defines the number of temporary files that can be created during the join operation and possibly subsequent sorting operations.
 Increase the number of temporary files to improve the performance of the node.
 Be aware that the operating system might impose a limit on the maximum number of open files.

fields.title: Hiliting enabled
fields.description: If selected, hiliting rows in the output will hilite the rows in the left and right input tables that contributed to that row. Equally, when hiliting a row in one of the input tables, all rows that the input row contributed to are hilited. Disabling this option reduces the memory footprint of the joiner, the disk footprint of the workflow, and may speed up the execution in cases where main memory is scarce.
